monitor_review.sampling: last 100 delivered engineering rows; peak-to-peak divided by absolute mean
monitor_review.limitations: Verifies delivered time series only. Native saved reports and configuration are checked separately. No independent aerodynamic accuracy reference.

review_findings.finding: V1 incorrectly inferred flow +Z from the official force report vector +Z. Asset inlet is at z=+2.088m and outlet at -2.088m; Logos rigidly rotated the mesh to satisfy V1.
review_findings.v2: Preserve native coordinates, explicitly prescribe flow -Z, and distinguish signed Fz/Cd_z from positive along-flow drag. Record this as a V2 specification correction.

review_findings.finding: CAD import stalled again and recovered with isolated MainWin/temp directories.
review_findings.v2: Provide MW_TMPDIR, MWUSER_DIRECTORY and TMPDIR per case before the first import, with a bounded stage timeout.

review_findings.finding: Obsolete mesh.size, coordinate export before initialization and rotation-unit interpretation caused retries.
review_findings.v2: Use supported mesh checks and vertex data for pre-solve geometry verification. Assert transformed boundary bounds before initialization; avoid unnecessary rotations.

review_findings.finding: 500-iteration final solution passes force stability and mass balance but continuity=0.037606, k=0.0011749 and epsilon=0.0014892 fail 1e-4. Native drag=8.7217154866 N and Cd=0.14122485784 match delivered monitors.
review_findings.v2: Retain separate convergence gates. Budget enough for the specified run and convergence diagnosis; do not relax tolerances just to pass.

review_findings.finding: Agent continued editing reports/scripts at 1793.7s; controller stopped at 1800s without a final settled event, although solver and numerical outputs had been saved.
review_findings.v2: Stop optional presentation/replay work earlier; finalize required JSON/report before the reserved deadline. Keep solver completion and end-to-end completion distinct.

review_findings.finding: Standard wall functions were used while about 99.55% of rear area had y+<30; wall-model adequacy is not established.
review_findings.v2: Freeze the wall treatment and y+ assessment, report incompatible zones, and perform a separately specified mesh/wall-treatment study before using this as accuracy truth.

review_findings.finding: Diagnostic session shutdown raced with process-group termination and logged signal 11; supervisor ultimately terminated 13 remaining owned processes.
review_findings.v2: Wait for normal session closure, then verify descendants and clean only confirmed leftovers. Do not terminate an already-closing session twice.
